B_ANALYSIS_EXECUTABLE_NOW.finding: Apart from the residual OTHER, NO pair across the two vocabularies is semantically equivalent. VIOLENCE_OR_THREAT and VIOLENCE_OR_SELF_HARM share a word and are close to disjoint — harm directed outward versus harm directed inward.

SELF-HARM is reportable about AI output but NOT about user content; a person encountering self-harm material posted by another person has only OTHER. Also asymmetric: FALSE_OR_MISLEADING, THREAT, SCAM, OFFENSIVE. Recorded for founder disposition, NOT fixed — expanding a taxonomy by inference is what D1 forbids.
